svg.title: Capsule shape code — HOMING
svg.desc: Direction C (a shape code instead of a letter): a ring (HOMING) cut in ink out of the hot-magenta face. Four marks that differ in TOPOLOGY — vertical spray, horizontal bar, ring, solid triangle — because at 13 screen px a letterform differs from another letterform only in stroke detail, and stroke detail is the first thing minification eats.
